name: What types of under-cabinet lighting are available for kitchens?

mainEntity.name: What types of under-cabinet lighting are available for kitchens?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group primarily integrates LED under-cabinet lighting into our kitchen renovations. Common types include LED strip lights, puck lights, and linear fixtures. LED strips offer continuous, even illumination, ideal for task lighting across countertops. Puck lights provide focused spots of light, often used to highlight specific areas or decorative elements. Linear fixtures combine the benefits of both, offering a more traditional appearance with efficient LED technology. The choice depends on the desired aesthetic, functional requirements, and the overall design vision for your custom kitchen, which we coordinate as part of our integrated design-build process.
acceptedAnswer.description: LED strip lights, puck lights, and linear LED fixtures are common types, each offering distinct aesthetic and functional benefits for kitchen under-cabinet lighting.
